label: VI-Rig 5 IMUs + 4 cams
title: VI-Rig: 5 IMUs + 4 cameras
intro: Our rig with two RealSense T265 units (two global-shutter fisheye pairs) and five IMUs: an Xsens MTi as base, a GX3-25, a GX3-35 and the two T265 IMUs. A one-off MVIS study of 7 recordings, not part of the leaderboard batch or the regression suite. Kalibr and Basalt were not run on it.
reading: Two T265 units, one board. They never see the board at the same time, so each camera-only solve holds one pair (time offset off: each pair is hardware-synced). The camera + IMU solves hold all four cameras and five IMUs, and their intrinsics start from the 7-recording median of the camera-only solves.

T265 IMU timing. The T265 IMUs' gyro–accel delay t_ga is about −6.6 ms, far from the other IMUs. MVIS estimates it per IMU; it is not a pure time shift (it depends on the motion's frequency), so read it as a compromise value.
The results files (calibration numbers and run configs, no images) are on Hugging Face beside the data, in its results folder dated 2026-11-02 (see the link above).
no_repeatability: This study has no repeatability cells: a cell compares how much each tool's estimates scatter, and only MVIS was run here. The spread of each MVIS value is in Parameters by sensor.
study_note: Separate study (batch 2026-11-02), MVIS only: Kalibr and Basalt were not run on this set, so it has no row here.
